entities.name: Décio Villares
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Décio Rodrigues Villares was a Brazilian painter, sculptor, caricaturist, and graphic designer. He is best known for helping to design the blue disc on the flag of Brazil and his designs for the monument honoring Júlio de Castilhos.

entities.summary: Décio Rodrigues Villares was a Brazilian painter, sculptor, caricaturist, and graphic designer. He is best known for helping to design the blue disc on the flag of Brazil and his designs for the monument honoring Júlio de Castilhos.
